pages.text: $(#8B4513)🍖 Dragon and Tiger Fusion · Golden Broth of Fortitude 🦴$()$(br2)$(l)$(#D2691E)「Tempered through medicinal broth, the mortal body briefly attains the strength of dragons and tigers」$()$(br)The essence of $(#6B8E23)legendary herbal broth$() seeps into $(#A9A9A9)dragon-marked bones$(), while $(#CD5C5C)frost-aged pork$() and $(#FF8C00)goblin carrots$() simmer in a $(#800000)vermillion phoenix claypot$()—a sacred secret of the South Seas, said to $(l)push mortal flesh beyond its limits$().

$(#8B0000)▌ Three Forces of Restoration $()$(br2)$(l)$(#8B4513)🦴 Ironbone Barrier$()$(br)Basalt-like $(#696969)stone veins$() appear on the skin, absorbing massive damage.$(br2)$(l)$(#D4AF37)💊 Tempered Golden Body$()$(br)Organs circulate with $(#FFD700)indestructible golden energy$().$(br2)$(l)$(#32CD32)✨ Bone and Blood Renewal$()$(br)Wounds burst forth with $(#7CFC00)emerald regenerative pathways$().

$(br2)$(#6B8E23)▌ Ancient Singapura Recipe $()$(br)- Use a $(#8B4513)black iron cleaver$() to chop $(#A9A9A9)dragon bones$() into $(#D3D3D3)seven-star linked beads$().$(br)- $(#CD5C5C)Pork$() must be slow-cooked with $(#6B8E23)medicinal broth$() for $(#FF4500)three incense sticks’ time$().$(br)- When adding $(#FF8C00)carrots$(), one must recite an $(#DAA520)ancient Teochew chant$().$(br2)$(#FF0000)⚠$() When the claypot emits a $(#8B0000)dragon’s roar$(), and $(#D4AF37)tiger-striped bone patterns$() appear on the surface, the brew is complete.

$(br2)$(#8B4513)『 Southern Herbal Cuisine Record 』$()$(br)An ancient scroll from Malacca:$(br)'This $(#8B0000)golden broth$(), guided by $(#6B8E23)the four-element foundation$(),$(br)draws strength from $(#A9A9A9)tiger bones$(), nurtures blood with $(#CD5C5C)pork essence$(),$(br)and enhances sight with $(#FF8C00)goblin roots$()—$(br)granting the drinker $(#8B4513)Tortoise Shell Protection$(),$(br)$(#D4AF37)White Tiger's Sharpness$(),$(br)and resilience even against $(#FF0000)Ender Dragon’s Breath$(),$(br)for the $(#32CD32)Azure Dragon’s life force$() shall not be easily broken.'
